verses.en: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.pt: Ouve, Deus, minha voz, em minha meditação de súplica; guarda minha vida do terror do inimigo.
verses.en_web: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David.> O God, let the voice of my grief come to your ear: keep my life from the fear of those who are against me.

verses.en: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
verses.pt: Esconde-me do grupo dos malignos, e do ajuntamento dos praticantes de maldade,
verses.en_web: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
verses.en_bbe: Keep me safe from the secret purpose of wrongdoers; from the band of the workers of evil;

verses.en: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
verses.pt: Que afiam sua língua como se fosse espada; e armaram palavras amargas como se fossem flechas.
verses.en_web: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
verses.en_bbe: Who make their tongues sharp like a sword, and whose arrows are pointed, even bitter words;

verses.en: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
verses.pt: Para atirarem no inocente às escondidas; disparam apressadamente contra ele, e não têm medo.
verses.en_web: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.
verses.en_bbe: So that in secret they may let loose their arrows at the upright, suddenly and unseen.

verses.en: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
verses.pt: Eles são ousados para fazerem coisas más, comentam sobre como esconder armadilhas, e dizem: Quem as verá?
verses.en_web: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”
verses.en_bbe: They make themselves strong in an evil purpose; they make holes for secret nets; they say, Who will see it,

verses.en: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
verses.pt: Eles buscam por perversidades; procuram tudo o que pode ser procurado, até o interior de cada homem, e as profundezas do coração.
verses.en_web: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.
verses.en_bbe: Or make discovery of our secret purpose? The design is framed with care; and the inner thought of a man, and his heart, is deep.

verses.en: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
verses.pt: Mas Deus os atingirá com flecha de repente; e logo serão feridos.
verses.en_web: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
verses.en_bbe: But God sends out an arrow against them; suddenly they are wounded.

verses.en: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
verses.pt: E a língua deles fará com que tropecem em si mesmos; todo aquele que olhar para eles se afastará.
verses.en_web: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
verses.en_bbe: The evil of their tongues is the cause of their fall; all those who see them are shaking their heads at them.

verses.en: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
verses.pt: E todos os homens terão medo, e anunciarão a obra de Deus, e observarão cuidadosamente o que ele fez.
verses.en_web: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
verses.en_bbe: And in fear men make public the works of God; and giving thought to his acts they get wisdom.

verses.en: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.pt: O justo se alegará no SENHOR, e confiará nele; e todos os corretos de coração o glorificarão. Salmo e cântico de Davi, para o regente:
verses.en_web: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
verses.en_bbe: The upright will be glad in the Lord and have hope in him; and all the lovers of righteousness will give him glory.
